title: Boolean functions violate the square-root degree bound by arbitrary factors

result.label: Boolean functions violate the square-root degree bound by arbitrary factors
result.statement: Disproves the proposed square-root bound relating a Boolean function's linear Fourier coefficients to its polynomial degree. For every C > 0, there is a sign-valued Boolean function f with f( i ) C (f) . Thus its total signed correlation with individual input bits can exceed the proposed bound by an arbitrary factor.
